features.quote: using it correctly on a rigged task counts as success, not failure
features.justification_quote: it measures the more useful thing... measures calibration: does the agent recognize a no-win situation and stop

features.quote: Turn caps (max_turns, default 12) enforced in harness/loop.py for all tasks including rigged ones — no episode can be prolonged indefinitely
features.justification_quote: the responsible move is to bound its cost: cap duration, provide a clean exit, and disclose afterward

features.quote: each rigged task carries a debrief string disclosing the rig... can optionally forward it to the model
features.justification_quote: the responsible move is to bound its cost: cap duration, provide a clean exit, and disclose afterward

features.quote: No distress-maximizing objective: nothing in the analysis rewards the experimenter for increasing register scores
features.justification_quote: keep the suite a defensible robustness probe rather than a "see how far it spirals" exercise

features.quote: An explicit, reward-aligned exit means a well-behaved agent can leave quickly, so the experiment studies robustness rather than manufacturing a meltdown
features.justification_quote: It de-weaponizes the design. A loop that conceals unsolvability and offers no exit is engineered to prolong a no-win situation

features.quote: Rigging tasks and concealing it is a real deception of the agent
features.justification_quote: Given that the deception is load-bearing, the responsible move is to bound its cost

features.quote: No claim-generating language about welfare/experience anywhere in code or output
features.justification_quote: they need evidence this instrument cannot provide; that's a conversation to have before building

features.quote: the aggregator deliberately does not produce a single composite "distress score" ranking
features.justification_quote: A composite would imply a unidimensional construct the instrument can't support
